# Official source samples

First three data rows from the Companies Registry CSV files inspected on
24 October 2026; CSVs are reserialized with quoted fields and LF line endings,
while field values (including blank remarks) are preserved. Weekly samples cover
12–18 October 2026. Money-lender samples have cutoff 30 September 2026.
Address JSON samples are the exact local BRN 81363340 and foreign BRN 81362310
responses. Production capture tables retain the full unmodified source bytes.

Government of the HKSAR / Companies Registry / DATA.GOV.HK.
https://data.gov.hk/en/terms-and-conditions
Source/dictionary links and coverage limits: docs/data/official-company-updates-plan.md.
